My goal is to maximize profit. Since I pay the second-highest bid if I win, bidding my true value is a dominant strategy in a second-price auction. This ensures I never pay more than my value and I win whenever my value is higher than the other bids. Given my value is $46, I will bid $46.

The optimal strategy in a second-price auction is to bid your true value. This is a dominant strategy, meaning it maximizes my profit regardless of what other bidders do. Bidding below my value risks losing a profitable opportunity, while bidding above my value risks winning at a loss. Since this is the first round and there's no history to learn from regarding other bidders' tendencies, I will stick to the dominant strategy.
